paragraphs.text: Drasus was one of Kytheon Iora 's irregulars from Akros on the plane of Theros .
Drasus was three years older than Kytheon, and hot-tempered.

Around age 16, Drasus was imprisoned in Akros for brawling and was there for a season before his friend Kytheon Iora was put in the same prison for stealing. Drasus was part of the defense of Akros against harpies and cyclopses four years later. He was killed along with the other irregulars when Heliod 's spear thrown by Kytheon was returned by Erebos .
